minutes.headline: Select Board heard of months of MUNIS billing failures and agreed to bring in Town Counsel over a possible breach.
minutes.summary: Sewer and finance staff described about seven months of failures in the MUNIS billing software, with late and mathematically wrong utility bills. The board agreed to involve Town Counsel, get an executive session update, and have tech-experienced members work with the town manager. It also approved a restaurant license, ratified seasonal appointments, approved a surplus property policy, and began reviewing the tax investigation report.

public_comment.topic: A neighbor's mailed tax payment has not cleared and he is shown delinquent; worried about MUNIS and tax revenue, and about hiring without support.
Agreed that patching on patches is bad practice; criticized the Cemetery Commission for not exploring a cemetery corporation and for seeking capital money.

what_happened.line: Staff described months of failures in the MUNIS billing software that produced late and mathematically wrong utility bills; the board agreed to bring in Town Counsel.
Members with technology experience will work directly with the town manager on the MUNIS problems, and the board will get an executive session update at its next meeting.
Sewer staff said the department has retained earnings it cannot reach without a town meeting, so bills must go out to produce revenue before fiscal year end.
The board approved a common victualler license, ratified seasonal appointments, and approved an updated surplus property policy.
The board began reviewing the tax investigative report summary, and an ARPA and budget task force discussion was set for the next agenda.

why_it_matters: Utility bills that are late or wrong, and a sewer fund that may fall short of revenue by fiscal year end, bear on what residents are billed and on whether a deficit lands on retained earnings.
The same software handles tax payments, and a resident reported a mailed payment shown as delinquent, so billing errors may reach tax accounts as well.
watch_next: The next Select Board meeting, for the executive session update from Town Counsel with the Sewer Commissioners and sewer business manager invited.
The next agenda, which is to carry the ARPA funds and budget task force discussion, with a composition and scope drafted by the town manager.
